$comment: Written by the Prism Obsidian plugin. `blocks` = status of the last render of each viz block, `errors` = errors of those renders, newest first. Line numbers are 1-based note lines. Entries are refreshed whenever a block renders in Obsidian (blocks render when visible). `interrupted` = the block was unloaded before it finished loading; render it with prism-render.mjs to get a result.
